algorithm: {We prioritize bins where adding the item would leave the remaining capacity closest to a small positive target, preferring bins that are already closer to full if ties occur.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_after = bins - item
    valid = remaining_after >= 0
    target = 0.1
    distance = np.abs(remaining_after - target)
    max_dist = np.max(distance) + 1 if len(distance) > 0 else 1
    distance[~valid] = max_dist
    priority_score = -distance
    tie_breaker = bins / (np.max(bins) + 1e-12)
    priority_score += tie_breaker * 1e-6
    return priority_score
